summary: Lists the requirements that congestion control mechanisms should meet for interactive, point-to-point real-time media such as video calls. Such traffic needs low delay and tolerates some loss, so it differs from bulk transfers and web browsing. The requirements are meant for judging candidate algorithms, particularly for WebRTC-style RTP traffic. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When many cars share a road, they must not all rush in at once or everybody gets stuck. This document lists the good manners that video-call traffic should follow so it shares the road fairly without making calls choppy.

questions: congestion control requirements for real-time video
what must rtp congestion control do
